body_package.description: the GA 12.5 body these targets are checked against: the ORIGINAL wk8 sculpt scaled x3.7154, skin unchanged, TruSoma physics at its own sourced sizes with only the joint posture fitted; tongue scaled x1.21 (the one sculpt change)

scope: ONLY the values TruSoma reads at GA 12.5 (body7 / oral7 / tongue7); see body_provenance.json for the display-only features

status_values.sourced_interpolated: at or between published anchors within 0.5 wk
status_values.derived: computed from sourced values by a stated rule
status_values.extrapolated: outside the source's data range (see gap_weeks)

check_values.computed_from_published_equation: equation from a secondary page, computed
check_values.abstract_read_values_verified: abstract read (Europe PMC / PubMed) and the numbers match; full text not read
check_values.search_summary_only: values seen only in a web-search summary of the paper; paper not read
check_values.code_citation_only: cited in trusoma code; paper not read here
check_values.trusoma_blind_verified: trusoma companion/source_audit: a second reader re-opened the source and recorded quote and value (abstract or table level); NOT re-read in this project
check_values.table_in_papers_folder_starts_at_14wk: table is in the papers folder and read; it starts at 14 wk

features.name: Crown-rump length
features.spread: SD 6.40 mm at 87.5 days (10.4%), from the standard's own equation SD = -2.21626 + 0.0984894 x GA in days; Papageorghiou 2014, open-access copy read 2026-11-10; its mean equation gives 61.65 mm

features.name: Biparietal diameter
features.method: 12+0 wk anchor blended to INTERGROWTH at 14 wk; Gjessing gives 19.5 mm at 12+0 and 23.0 mm at 12+6, so 12.5 wk lies between two published points

sculpt.method: skin vertices within 0.5 R of the sourced head ellipsoid (skin adds 1-2 mm)

features.name: Occipitofrontal diameter
features.note: growth7 itself holds the 14-wk cephalic index below 14 wk; Chitty covers 12.5 directly

features.name: Abdominal circumference
features.method: 14-wk value scaled by the CRL ratio

features.name: Neck circumference
features.spread: SD 6.5 mm at 12.5 wk (19%), from the nomogram's own equation SD (cm) = 3.15 - 0.3823 GA + 0.01733 GA^2 - 0.0002179 GA^3, extrapolated 1.5 wk below its data (14-40 wk); Sherer 2007 (J Ultrasound Med 26:1529-37, PMID 17957047), abstract read 2026-11-10; its mean equation gives 34.86 mm

features.name: Humerus length
features.spread: four specimens at crown-rump length 61-63 mm: 12.9-14.1 mm, mean 13.43; residual SD 1.2 mm about a line through 15 specimens of 50-71 mm (Bareggi 1994 Table 1)
features.method: whole humerus, linear between the class means at crown-rump length 53 and 64 mm (Bareggi 1994 Table 2)
features.note: 2026-11-11: target changed from the ultrasound shaft length to the whole bone the physics body has used since 2026-11-05 (audit item M-068); the sculpt figures below were taken against the shaft target

features.name: Femur length
features.spread: not recorded for the whole bone; the ultrasound shaft at 12+0 to 12+6 wk is 9.15 +- 1.44 mm (Chen 2007), a different quantity
features.method: whole femur at crown-rump length 62 mm: 14.19 mm (Ishikawa 2026 Table 1; Takakuwa 2023 fit; Suzuki 2019 gives 14.46)
features.note: 2026-11-11: target changed from the ultrasound shaft length to the whole bone the physics body has used since 2026-11-05 (audit item M-068); the sculpt figures below were taken against the shaft target

features.name: Ulna length
features.method: whole ulna, linear between the class means at crown-rump length 53 and 64 mm (Bareggi 1994 Table 2)
features.note: 2026-11-11: target changed from the ultrasound shaft length to the whole bone the physics body has used since 2026-11-05 (audit item M-068); the sculpt figures below were taken against the shaft target
features.spread: four specimens at 61-63 mm: 8.0-12.0 mm, mean 9.52 (Bareggi 1994 Table 1)

features.name: Tibia length
features.method: 14-wk tibia/femur ratio x the whole femur 14.19 mm
features.note: 2026-11-11: target changed from the ultrasound shaft length to the whole bone the physics body has used since 2026-11-05 (audit item M-068); the sculpt figures below were taken against the shaft target

features.name: Foot length
features.method: Streeter sitting-height rows dated by INTERGROWTH, log-interpolated

features.name: Tongue length
features.spread: 13 wk, n 23: median 8.0 mm, 5th-95th centile 6.9-9.0 (SD 0.64 mm, 8%); Koren 2023 Table 4, read 2026-11-10
features.method: growth7 holds the Koren 2023 13-wk median (Tables 4 and 5: 8.0 x 6.5 mm) at its OFD ratio below 13 wk, linear to the 14-wk row between

sculpt.method: PCA extent of the tongue mesh after the x1.21 scale (original 5.53)

features.name: Tongue width
features.spread: 13 wk, n 23: median 6.5 mm, 5th-95th centile 5.4-7.6 (SD 0.67 mm, 10%); Koren 2023 Table 5, read 2026-11-10
features.method: growth7 holds the Koren 2023 13-wk median (Tables 4 and 5: 8.0 x 6.5 mm) at its OFD ratio below 13 wk, linear to the 14-wk row between

features.name: Hard palate length
features.spread: 12 wk: 6.38 +- 0.39 mm; 13 wk: 7.35 +- 0.50 mm (SD 6-7%), measured as the premaxilla-to-posterior distance; Liao 2025 Table 1, read 2026-11-10
features.method: Sherer 2004 15-wk value scaled by the Liao 2025 PMD regression ratio (1.16 w - 7.86) from 12.5 wk; below 12.5 wk the 12.5 wk value is held at its OFD ratio
features.note: applied in c1m growth7 (1ea717d). Liao and Sherer measure the palate from different landmarks; the ratio is stable for length (about 1.30 over 15-20 wk)

features.name: Hard palate width
features.method: Sherer 2004 15-wk value scaled by the Liao 2025 transverse regression ratio (0.71 w - 1.04) from 12.5 wk; below 12.5 wk the 12.5 wk value is held at its OFD ratio
features.note: applied in c1m growth7 (1ea717d). CAVEAT: the landmark offset between Liao and Sherer drifts for width (ratio 1.23 down to 1.09 over 15-20 wk), so the 12.5 wk width carries more uncertainty than the length

S01.cite: Papageorghiou AT et al. INTERGROWTH-21st fetal growth standards: CRL. Ultrasound Obstet Gynecol 2014;44:641
S01.note: equation in growth7.crl; growth7 also applies it below 9 wk
S01.note_audit: INTERGROWTH CRL equation re-opened by a second reader; data 9+0 to 13+6 wk, CRL 15-95 mm (covers 12.5 wk)

S02.cite: Gjessing HK et al. 2024 Ultrasound Obstet Gynecol (BPD 19.5 mm at 12+0 wk)
S02.note_audit: Gjessing 2024: BPD 19.5 mm at 12+0 wk and 23.0 mm at 12+6 wk (outer-to-outer)

S03.cite: Chitty LS et al. 1994 fetal head biometry (OFD = -41.58 + 5.50*GA - 0.0009141*GA^3, valid 12-42 wk)

S04.cite: Wozniak 2006 CS20-23; Wozniak & Bruska 1999 femur; Chen 2007 first-trimester fetal limb biometry, 12+0 to 14+6 wk, n=1489 (FL 11.45 mm at 13+0-13+6); trusoma audit batch_2026-10-18e res_promote_body.json
S04.note: the local Wozniak PDF covers embryo stages 18-23 (CRL up to about 30 mm, under 10 wk); the 12.5 wk anchor comes from Chen 2007, which is not in the papers folder

S05.cite: Chitty LS, Altman DG 2002 fetal long bone and foot nomograms (via body_size)

S06.cite: Streeter GL 1920 (foot length by sitting height; cadaver series)
S06.note_audit: Streeter 1920 rows (sitting height, foot length) re-opened by a second reader

S07.cite: Koren N et al. Fetal micro and macroglossia: defining normal fetal tongue size. J Ultrasound Med 2023;42:59-70
S07.local: C:\Projects\Kootru-Labs\docs\J of Ultrasound Medicine - 2022 - Koren - Fetal Micro and Macroglossia.pdf
S07.note: Tables 4-5 read here: 13-wk median 8.0 x 6.5 mm, 14-wk 9.2 x 7.8. trusoma audit lists the KOREN rows as unresearched (paywalled), so this read upgrades them

S08.cite: Liao R et al. Ultrasound detection of fetal palate development in the early second trimester. Cleft Palate Craniofac J 2025;62:21-27
S08.note: Table 1 and regressions read; single-centre Chinese cohort; landmarks include the alveolar bone

S10.cite: Sherer DM et al. Nomograms of fetal hard palate width, length and area. Ultrasound Obstet Gynecol 2004;24:35-41
S10.note: landmarks and scan plane NOT verified (full text unavailable)

S11.cite: Sherer DM et al. Fetal neck circumference. J Ultrasound Med 2007;26:1529

S12.note: the local table starts at 14 wk (50th centile 80.6 mm), confirming AC at 12.5 wk is extrapolated

S20.cite: Modi K, Chaturvedi A, Ahmad A, Bhadoria P. Morphometry of fetal liver from human fetuses between 12-36 wk (hand/foot ratio from the group means: 0.81 at 12-16 wk)
S20.note: supports growth7.HAND_OVER_FOOT = 0.81 at 12-16 wk; trusoma audit batch_2026-10-18b res_growth.json
